successor: Erligang (early Shang) state centred at Zhengzhou, with walled city at Yanshi
source1: Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'Erlitou culture' (first state-level society in China; palatial buildings, royal tombs) - https://www.britannica.com/topic/Erlitou-culture
source2: Li Liu and Hong Xu, 'Rethinking Erlitou: legend, history and Chinese archaeology', Antiquity 81(314), 2007, 886-901 (only the abstract was accessible; site sequence details came from leads) - https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/antiquity/article/abs/rethinking-erlitou-legend-history-and-chinese-archaeology/FDBD0E8E7C661FC180CAD54AD9742E31
notes: Palatial state, no texts. c.1600 BCE an Erligang walled city was built at Yanshi 6 km away; Erlitou elite production ceased, palaces abandoned by Upper Erligang; no destruction layer. Erligang takeover inferred. Britannica dates culture to 1350 BCE.
